title: Next-hour lead
question: Does a probability shock tell us where the related asset goes in the following hour?
headline: Next-hour direction after shocks: hit rate nan% (95% CI nan% to nan%, 0 markets). Next-hour size effect vs unrelated assets: +nan× (CI +nan to +nan).
notes: Direction uses the sign of each market-asset co-movement estimated on earlier hours only.
Pass rule (direction): hit rate above 50% with the 95% CI above 50%; < 30 markets = inconclusive. The size effect is reported as secondary (useful for a volatility warning).
